name: Infotel SA
summary: Infotel SA designs, develops, markets, and maintains software solutions in the areas of security, performance, and management in France, rest of Europe, and the United States. It operates through two segments, Software and Services. The company offers Arcsys, an archiving platform for electronic data; iDBA-Online, an intelligent management solution for administration and maintenance operations for DB2 databases; and Infoscope, a quality control software solution. It also provides InfoPak, InfoVic, and InfoUtil, as well as Orlando, a software solution for manufacturers in the aerospace industry; Deepeo, which offers a response to data protection; and utilities for Db2 for z/OS and LUW.
